text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The claim is contradicted by both retrieved sources, which directly establish that RANK-RANKL signalling drives the development of Aire-expressing mTECs. Source 3952288 shows RANKL signals from CD4+3− inducer cells promote maturation of RANK-expressing CD80−Aire− mTEC progenitors into CD80+Aire+ mTECs, with RANK-deficient thymic stroma inducing autoimmunity. Source 301838 independently reports that emergence of the first Aire+ mTEC cohorts is jointly directed by Rankl+ lymphoid tissue inducer cells and Vγ5+ DETC progenitors, describing a Rank-mediated link to Aire+ mTEC maturation.", "evidence_used": ["3952288", "301838"]}
